title: LoL Esports |
content:
Riot Games is honored to announce Rasmus “Caps” Winther as the third inductee into the LoL Esports Hall of Legends. Known as a beacon of hope whose legacy reshaped what the West believed was possible on the global stage, Caps becomes the first Western League of Legends pro to earn the distinction.

Widely regarded as the defining Western player of his generation, Caps built his legacy through a rare blend of elite skill, creativity, and authenticity. From his meteoric rise as a rookie to becoming the most decorated player in European League of Legends history, Caps has consistently proven he can stand toe-to-toe with the world’s best while staying true to his own style. Known as both a dependable teammate and an innovative force on the Rift, he inspires those around him to play boldly and push the boundaries of what’s possible. Off the Rift, Caps’ warmth, humility, and sense of camaraderie have made him a beloved figure among teammates and fans alike. In an era where many chased established trends, Caps became a beacon of hope for the West: living proof that individuality, joy, and creativity can compete at the highest level.

“Caps always felt like the player you could never fully prepare for,” said Chris Greeley, Global Head of LoL Esports. “He has that rare ‘it’ factor, the ability to rise in the biggest moments through his playmaking, leadership, and calming presence under pressure. Caps has inspired an entire generation of Western players and earned the respect of fans around the world. He’s not just one of the greatest League of Legends players of all time, he exemplifies everything we hope our esports heroes can be.”

Caps will be celebrated at the official Hall of Legends Trophy Ceremony in Berlin, Germany, on August 18. Caps also will be honored throughout the duration of the Hall of Legends in-game event beginning September 10, which includes an event pass that will guide players throughout his career and dedicated cosmetic items. More details to come soon.

To learn more about Caps and Hall of Legends, visit theHall of Legends websitebeginning August 24.

Every year, LoL Esports inducts a pro player into the Hall of Legends to honor their achievements within the sport and game. A list of approximately 20 players that have played for at least five cumulative years in Tier 1 competition are nominated by key Riot staff in each region and put forth to an independent, 50-person voting panel made up of esports industry veterans from every region. This panel then votes for players based on criteria including international berths, international and regional titles, role specific stats, and overall contributions to the sport.

title: Rasmus 'Caps' Winther Becomes First Western Player Inducted into LoL Hall of Legends
summary: Rasmus 'Caps' Winther Becomes First Western Player Inducted into LoL Hall of Legends  Inven Global
content:
Riot Games has announced the schedule to honor G2 Esports mid laner 'Caps' Rasmus Winther, who has been selected as the third legend in the Hall of Legends and the first from a Western region.

Riot Games announced on the 16th that Rasmus Winther has been chosen as the third inductee into the Hall of Legends—the highest honor for players who have left a remarkable mark on the League of Legends esports stage—and the first Western player to receive the distinction.

As a representative player of the Western region, Rasmus Winther began his professional career at Fnatic and has continued to demonstrate top-tier performance since moving to G2 Esports. He set a monumental record by winning the League of Legends EMEA Championship (LEC) 17 times. Additionally, he was a runner-up at the World Championship with Fnatic in 2018 and G2 Esports in 2019, and he reached the top of the podium at the 2019 Mid-Season Invitational.

Still highly active in the professional scene, Rasmus Winther has consistently shown strength against LCK teams. He defeated SK Telecom T1 in the 2019 Mid-Season Invitational semifinals and went on to reach the finals of that year's World Championship after consecutive victories over DAMWON Gaming in the quarterfinals and SK Telecom T1 in the semifinals. He further proved his competitiveness by defeating T1 3-1 in the second round of the lower bracket at the 2026 Mid-Season Invitational, held in Daejeon, South Korea.

The schedule for the induction celebrations has also been finalized. An official trophy presentation ceremony will take place in Berlin, Germany, on the 18th (local time), followed by in-game commemorative events starting September 10. During this period, players will be able to access an event pass celebrating his career, along with special commemorative cosmetic items.

Chris Greeley, Global Head of LoL Esports, stated, "Rasmus 'Caps' Winther feels like an unpredictable player. Through his playmaking, leadership, and calm presence under pressure, he possesses a decisiveness that shines in critical moments. He has inspired all Western players and earned the respect of fans worldwide. Beyond being one of the greatest League of Legends players of all time, he is the embodiment of everything an esports hero should be."
